blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government has disbursed ₱750 million for recovery efforts in northern Cebu in the year since a magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck the area. The amount forms the province’s share of the estimated ₱19-billion recovery cost for 10 municipalities and one city affected by the Sept. 30, 2025 earthquake. Provincial […]...
